header.title: Describe how {organizationName} participates in the market.
header.body: Your organization confirms its capabilities. Supporting documents, industry codes, project history, and preferences add context but do not automatically verify a capability.

assistance.title: Start in your own words
assistance.placeholder: For example: We inspect and repair commercial stormwater systems…
assistance.help: Suggestions help you find relevant AMACS capabilities. They do not certify your organization or change your profile until you save a capability.
assistance.editHelp: Editing helps clarify what you mean. Select the AMACS capability that best fits before saving it to your organization.

catalog.title: Browse Domain → Family → Capability
catalog.search: Search labels, aliases, definitions, and hierarchy

claim.title: Review this capability
claim.marketRole: Market role · select at least one
claim.serviceGeography: Service geography · select at least one
claim.boundaryBody: Saving adds this capability to your organization profile. Verification, RFx qualification, and credibility are separate.

confirmed.title: Confirmed capabilities
confirmed.emptyBody: Describe the organization in plain language or browse the AMACS catalog to add a capability.

provisional.summary: None of the catalog terms fit
provisional.body: Suggest a new term instead of choosing an inaccurate capability. Proposed terms do not affect matching until they are added to AMACS and selected for your organization.

industry.title: Industry and NAICS context
industry.body: Use these descriptors to explain markets served. They are not proof that the organization performs a capability.
industry.industries: Industries served · comma or line separated
industry.selectorBody: Select an exact six-digit industry from the {version} classification published by the {source}.
industry.existingBody: These values were saved previously. Keep them until you are ready to replace or remove them.
industry.boundaryBody: NAICS and industry data do not establish capability, certification, eligibility, qualification, or procurement readiness.

experience.title: Add past performance
experience.body: Record project context that helps others understand your work. Keep customer, contract, financial, and supporting details private unless you choose to share them.
experience.disclose: Allow this value to be shown at the selected visibility
experience.outcomes: Outcomes reported · comma or line separated
experience.boundaryBody: Adding this project does not automatically verify the experience or award credibility.
experience.emptyBody: Add a project when it helps others understand the organization’s work.

preferences.title: Teaming, referral, and resource preferences
preferences.body: Describe how the organization would like to participate. Preferences do not promise availability, commitment, endorsement, or a legal relationship.

notices.genericSaveError: Review the fields and try again.
notices.suggestionsReadyBody: These AMACS suggestions do not change your profile until you choose one and save it.
notices.assistanceUnavailableBody: Browse or search the AMACS catalog below; the manual path remains available.
notices.confirmedBody: Review scope, roles, geography, and visibility below, then save the capability to your organization.
notices.editedBody: Use the catalog to select the capability that best matches your corrected description before saving it to your organization.
notices.nonAuthoritativeBody: This suggestion will not affect discovery or matching unless you save a capability to your organization.
notices.dispositionErrorBody: Refresh and review the suggestion again.
notices.closedBody: None of these suggestions will affect your profile. Search manually or suggest a new term.
notices.claimSavedBody: The capability is now part of your organization profile and can be used in discovery according to its visibility. It is not independently verified.
notices.industrySavedBody: Industry and NAICS are descriptive context. They do not prove capability or procurement readiness.
notices.industryConflictBody: Another update changed this profile. The latest industry and NAICS information has been restored; review it before saving again.
notices.experienceSavedBody: The project is recorded as information provided by your organization. No verification, qualification, or credibility was awarded.
notices.preferencesSavedBody: These preferences describe interests only. They do not promise availability or create a referral or teaming relationship.
notices.provisionalSavedBody: The proposed term is awaiting review and cannot satisfy an AMACS capability requirement unless it is added to the standard.
